# Building the Technical Writing Function

The partner-facing technical writing function didn't have a dedicated manager. So in 2023, I made the case for one. I was promoted into the role and became the first Technical Writing Manager for the org.

## What I Built

I built and led a globally distributed team of 7 contributors (full-time and contract) spanning the U.S. and Japan, and moved the team toward a documentation function with clear architectural standards and measurable business outcomes.

- **Governance:** Established a centralized project management infrastructure, resolving 230+ accumulated issues and reducing average resolution time by 23.55%.
- **Cross-timezone delivery:** Implemented async standups and review protocols to synchronize workflows between Austin and Tokyo, enabling consistent 24-hour delivery cycles.
- **Japanese doc coverage:** Partnered with operations to hire and onboard Tokyo-based writers, driving Japanese API documentation coverage to 88% against a 50% target.
- **Information architecture:** Led a site-wide IA overhaul that improved content discoverability and unblocked the Knowledge Management team's AI assistant integration.
- **Function charter:** Developed the first Technical Writing Vision document for the org, securing VP-level alignment on a roadmap centered on AI-enhanced documentation.

## Delivery Under Pressure

The team navigated two major reorganizations during this period without disruption to delivery. High-stakes milestones, like including board-level product launches requiring full compliance with integration standards, shipped on schedule.

## Continued Strategic Leadership (2025–Present)

In July 2025, I moved into a senior individual contributor role. My relationship to the function didn't change. I continue to serve as the strategic lead for the technical writing team.

- Wrote the team charter and strategy document that secured VP-level buy-in, establishing a shared direction for the function post-transition.
- Defined and own two OKR key results for the team, including both goal-setting and outcome tracking.

> *"Although I manage the tech writers, I rely on Rebecca to lead most of the team's work."*
> — **Senior Product Director, former manager**
